title: Noticed Termination Damages: Damages kWh, Months Counted and Rate
content:
## Damages of a noticed termination - Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts

1. The damages of a noticed termination are its damages kWh multiplied by its damages rate, rounded half up to the cent only at that step, but not less than the structure's minimum early termination fee.
2. The damages kWh of a noticed termination are its annual kWh multiplied by its months counted and divided by 12 months per year, rounded half up to a whole kWh, and that figure is billed as the remaining contracted kWh of the line.
3. The annual kWh of a noticed termination are the kWh billed on the contract's supply lines posted in the twelve months before the handling date. A line falls in the twelve months before the handling date when it was posted on or before the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.
4. The months counted for a noticed termination are twelve times the difference in years plus the difference in months between the termination effective date and the contract end date, plus one when the day of month of the contract end date is later than the day of month of the termination effective date.
5. The damages rate of a noticed termination is the structure's liquidated damages rate per remaining contracted kWh.

## Worked through (hypothetical figures)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| termination effective date | 5 May 2026 |
| contract end date | 31 December 2027 |
| months counted: twelve times 1, plus 12 less 5, that is 19; plus one because day 31 is later than day 5 | 20 |
| annual kWh on supply lines posted in the twelve months | 2415300 |
| damages kWh: 2415300 multiplied by 20, divided by 12 | 4025500 |
| damages rate of a structure at $0.0060 per kWh | $0.0060 |
| damages: 4025500 multiplied by 0.0060 | $24153.00 |
| minimum fee of that structure, $750.00 | not reached |
| damages billed | $24153.00 |

## Further cases (hypothetical)

- Termination effective date 20 March 2026, contract end date 10 January 2027: twelve times 1 plus 1 less 3 gives 10; day 10 is not later than day 20, so 10 months are counted.
- Annual kWh of 310000 and 2 months counted give 51666.67, rounded half up to 51667 kWh; at $0.0020 per kWh that is $103.33, below a minimum of $250.00, so $250.00 is billed.
